scenario: 今天的检索赛道在问，召回阶段到底有没有把真正该看的东西带进来。社区图文搜索要把意图写进召回，长文档要把图表和跨页关系一起找回，多跳问答还得顺着已检索页面上的链接走。搜索 agent 会被转抄的回声带偏，视觉查询则在进检索器之前就可能是歪的、糊的。另一边，有人在看 embedding 要不要再跑一遍层，要不要先擦掉干扰属性，要不要换到能保住层次的双曲空间，以及更小的生物医学编码器能不能靠面向检索的预训练超过更大的模型。还有一篇讨论重排的博客提醒，向量检索找得近，并不等于找得对，对照问题再打一遍分，往往比先换更大的模型更容易量起来。

papers.title: IntentFlow: An Intent-Driven Real-Time Multimodal Search System with Image-Text Queries at Xiaohongshu
papers.authors: Dongjia Zhao, Yuchen Ma, Chunsheng Shi, Ziqiu Gui, Chao Yuan, Jianing Zhu, Zhaoxing Zhang, Yahui Liu, Daoxin Zhang, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Cheng Chen
papers.abstract: Multimodal search with image-text queries helps users find notes in user-generated content (UGC) communities and serves as a key search tool for multimodal search agents. For such queries, query-note relevance depends on the user's retrieval intent and cannot be determined by visual or topical similarity alone. Simply reranking visual search results cannot fully address this challenge, as notes relevant to the user's intent may be missing from the initial candidate set. This motivates explicit intent modeling to align candidate retrieval and reranking under consistent relevance criteria. We present IntentFlow, an intent-driven real-time multimodal search system deployed at Xiaohongshu over an index on the order of ten billion entries. IntentFlow represents retrieval objectives with a hierarchical intent taxonomy and uses intent-specific relevance criteria to guide data construction, representation learning, and reranking. An offline agentic data workflow acquires candidates and verifies their relevance under these criteria to produce training supervision. The embedding model combines intent-aware contrastive learning, graded ranking, and distribution distillation, while a compact reranker assesses query-candidate evidence conditioned on predicted hierarchical intents. Evaluations demonstrate that IntentFlow delivers substantial gains in search engagement while supporting real-time search at industrial scale. In a user-level A/B test on the Xiaohongshu platform, IntentFlow outperforms the existing production system based on visual search followed by reranking, achieving relative gains of 28.17% in Top-4 query click-through rate, 18.96% in query click-through rate, and 12.56% in average time spent on search results pages per user. Production monitoring records an end-to-end P50 latency of 1.07 s.
papers.summary: 在用户生成内容社区里，图文混合查询的相关性取决于用户想找什么，不能只靠视觉或主题相似来定。只把视觉检索结果再排一次，相关笔记可能根本不在候选里。IntentFlow 在小红书上用分层意图体系来统一候选召回和精排的相关性标准，并据此构造训练数据和表示学习。在用户级分流的线上对照实验中，相对原先先做视觉检索再精排的生产对照组，前四条结果的查询点击率提高 28.17%，查询点击率提高 18.96%，人均在结果页停留时长提高 12.56%。==图文搜索要先对准意图，而不是先把看起来像的笔记召回来再补救==。对做社区或多模态搜索的人来说，意图得写进召回，而不能只留在精排。

deep_reading.title: IntentFlow: An Intent-Driven Real-Time Multimodal Search System with Image-Text Queries at Xiaohongshu

papers.title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes
papers.authors: Shihao Yang, Can Zeng, Xinzhe Li
papers.abstract: Search agents trained with reinforcement learning decide what to retrieve, when to search again, and when to answer. In real corpora, one claim is copied and paraphrased across many pages while the primary source settling a question appears once. We show that reinforcement-learned search agents grant echoes the credence of independent sources and lose their ability to abstain. Across five base models from 3B to 32B and seven released RL agents on multi-hop Wikipedia questions with primary evidence intact, eight paraphrased false-claim echoes overturn 58-73% of previously correct answers, while exact-match RL drives deleted-evidence abstention below 15%. Conditioning on retrieval localizes the failure to evidence acquisition: once primary evidence enters context, agents overrule eight echoes as reliably as one, whereas echoes fill top ranks and halt search early, so larger budgets, forced search turns, or passive passage filtering alone fail to recover displaced evidence. We introduce EchoSpec, specifying reliability across five corpus transformations with known target answers and training in two stages. Verification warm-start teaches multi-hop bridge-entity recovery past echoes, after which group RL optimizes an evidence-gated $\lambda$-reward with an outcome-independent acquisition bonus and scale-preserving advantages retaining the optimal rule $\lambda/(1+\lambda)$. Across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B backbones on nine evaluation suites, EchoSpec cuts eight-echo deference by 30-44 points on Qwen2.5-7B down to 29-31%, nearly quadruples eight-echo reach to 26-27% with zero-shot transfer to unseen BGE and BM25 retrievers, and raises standalone QA precision to 47-55%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/unihsy/EchoSpec.
papers.summary: 真实语料里，同一说法会被许多页面转抄改写，真正能定论的原始出处却往往只出现一次。用强化学习训练的搜索 agent，容易把这些回声当成彼此独立的证据，八条改写过的错误回声就能推翻 58% 到 73% 原先正确的答案。EchoSpec 先教模型在回声里把桥接实体找回来，再用带证据门控的奖励做分组强化学习。在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，它对八条回声的盲从降低了 30 到 44 个点，并且能零样本迁移到未见过的检索器。一旦原证进入上下文，模型对八条回声也能像对一条那样驳回。==搜索 agent 的问题常常不是不会答，而是还没拿到真正的出处就停搜了==。对要在开放语料上做多跳问答的人来说，训练时得奖励找到原证，而不能只奖励最后答对。

deep_reading.title: EchoSpec: Training Search Agents to Weigh Evidence Above Echoes

papers.title: DetouR: Plugging Association Routes into Search Agents for Multi-hop Question Answering
papers.authors: Tingwei Chen, Yunxiao Shi, Zhendong Chu, Zhiying Deng, Min Xu, Qingsong Wen
papers.abstract: Search agents answer multi-hop questions by interleaving reasoning with retrieval, deciding at each step what to search next. Existing agents follow semantic routes: they infer what is missing and phrase it as a query, reaching only what the model can name. Yet the decisive page is often one the question never names, frequently just one hyperlink away from evidence already retrieved. Following such association routes reaches more gold pages than semantic search under the same budget. Exploiting them raises two challenges: obtaining the association structure without costly offline graph construction, and keeping linked evidence in the reader's limited context, where relevance- and fusion-based selection discards it. We propose DetouR, a plug-in that reuses the links arriving with retrieved pages and adds no search or LLM call. Link Rerouting replaces near-repeat queries with routes to linked pages, chosen by a lightweight learned scorer; Chain-aware Context Selection runs personalized PageRank over these links so that evidence chains reach the reader intact. Across four agents, DetouR improves EM by 4.0 points on 2Wiki and 1.4 on HotpotQA on average. We also find that heavier LLM models struggle with this non-semantic evidence, adding little over these simple selectors or even falling behind. In summary, our work reveals association routes as a cheap complement to semantic routes that current search agents overlook: added as a plug-in, they improve every agent we test, in replay and in live runs, at no extra search or LLM cost.
papers.summary: 多跳问答里，搜索 agent 常按语义去补缺失信息，却到不了问题里没点名、其实就在已检索页面链接后的那一页。在同样预算下，顺着这类关联路径能碰到更多金标准页面，但离线建图贵，相关性和融合式筛选又常把链接证据挤出有限上下文。DetouR 作为插件复用页面自带的链接，不再额外搜索，也不再调用大模型：用轻量打分把近重复查询改道到链接页，再用个性化 PageRank 让证据链完整进入阅读上下文。在四个 agent 上，它平均把 2Wiki 的精确匹配提高 4.0 分，把 HotpotQA 提高 1.4 分。==有用的下一跳，常常不在模型能叫出名字的查询里，而在已经拿到的那一页的链接上==。对做多跳搜索 agent 的人来说，关联路径是对语义搜索的廉价补充，不必再加一次检索或模型调用。

papers.title: LMEG-Doc: Layout-Grounded Multi-View Evidence Graphs for Multimodal Long-Document Retrieval
papers.authors: Changcheng Fu, Xiao Liu, Qi Yu, Yage Wang, Derek Young, Giri Iyengar
papers.abstract: Retrieving relevant evidence from multimodal long documents remains challenging, as supporting information is often distributed across different pages and modalities. Existing retrieval methods primarily rank document elements by their individual similarity to a question, often overlooking relationships among complementary evidence. Consequently, relevant figures and tables may receive low retrieval scores even when they contain essential information. To address this limitation, we introduce LMEG-Doc, a layout-grounded multi-view evidence graph framework for multimodal long-document retrieval. We first construct an evidence graph that captures structural and contextual relationships among document elements, and introduce Cross-Page Relation Refinement (CRR) to discover additional connections across distant pages through VLM-based verification. Building on this graph, we combine multimodal retrieval signals with graph-guided relevance propagation to recover connected supporting evidence at both layout and page levels. Experiments on MMDocIR, DocScope, and FinRAGBench-V demonstrate consistent retrieval improvements, including outperforming retrievers fine-tuned on MMDocIR without task-specific training. Furthermore, augmenting existing question-answering pipelines with our retrieved evidence improves answer accuracy by 7.6% on DocScope and 15.8% on FinRAGBench-V, demonstrating the effectiveness of relationship-aware multimodal retrieval.
papers.summary: 从长文档里找证据时，有用信息常散落在不同页和不同模态，只按每段文字或图表与问题的单独相似度排序，相关图和表可能被排得很低。LMEG-Doc 先按版式和上下文把文档元素连成证据图，再用视觉语言模型补上跨页关系，然后把多模态检索信号沿着图传播，把互相支撑的证据一并找回。它在 MMDocIR、DocScope 和 FinRAGBench-V 上检索都有提升，并且不必为任务单独训练，也能超过在 MMDocIR 上微调过的检索器。把找回的证据补进现有问答流程后，Qwen3.8-27B 在 DocScope 上的答案准确率提高 7.6%，在 FinRAGBench-V 上提高 15.8%。==长文档检索不能只给单独元素打分，还得看见它们之间的版式和跨页关系==。对做财报或手册问答的人来说，把相连证据一起召回，往往比把单段相似度再调高一点更有用。

papers.title: Fix Before Search: Benchmarking Agentic Visual Query Pre-processing in Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation
papers.authors: Shenglai Zeng, Jiankun Zhang, Kai Guo, Xinnan Dai, Hui Liu, Jiliang Tang, Yi Chang
papers.abstract: Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a key paradigm for grounding MLLMs with external knowledge. While query pre-processing (e.g., rewriting) is standard in text-based RAG, existing MRAG pipelines predominantly treat visual inputs as static and immutable, implicitly assuming they are noise-free. However, real-world visual queries are often “imperfect”—suffering from geometric distortions, quality degradation, or semantic ambiguity—leading to catastrophic retrieval failures. To address this gap, we propose V-QPP-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark dedicated to Visual Query Pre-processing (V-QPP). We formulate V-QPP as an agentic decision-making task where MLLMs must autonomously diagnose imperfections and deploy perceptual tools to refine queries. Our extensive evaluation across 46,700 imperfect queries and diverse MRAG paradigms reveals three critical insights: (1) Vulnerability—visual imperfections severely degrade both retrieval recall and end-to-end MRAG performance; (2) Restoration Potential & Bottleneck—while oracle preprocessing recovers near-perfect performance, off-the-shelf MLLMs struggle with tool selection and parameter prediction without specialized training; and (3) Training Enhancement—supervised fine-tuning enables compact models to achieve comparable or superior performance to larger proprietary models, demonstrating the benchmark’s value for developing robust MRAG systems The code is available at https://github.com/phycholosogy/VQQP_Bench
papers.summary: 多模态检索增强生成里，文本查询常会先改写，视觉查询却往往被当成干净、不可改的输入。真实视觉查询常有变形、画质下降或语义含糊，检索会严重失败。V-QPP-Bench 把视觉查询预处理写成一种 agent 决策：模型要自己判断缺陷，并调用感知工具把查询修好。评测覆盖 46,700 条有缺陷的查询。视觉缺陷会明显拉低召回和端到端表现。预先按正确步骤修好后，性能可以接近完好输入，但现成多模态大模型在选工具和预测参数上仍吃力，监督微调能让小模型赶上或超过更大的专有模型。==视觉查询不能默认是干净的，搜索前先修图，有时比换检索器更要紧==。对做图文检索增强生成的人来说，查询预处理应单独评测和训练，而不是假定输入没有噪声。

papers.title: When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?
papers.abstract: We ask whether a compact universal multimodal embedding models can produce better search embeddings by running the same layers again. Looped transformers add computation with nearly unchanged model size, making them an appealing alternative to a larger encoder. Their success in language-model reasoning and recent use for retrieval motivate the idea, but higher retrieval scores alone do not reveal what an extra pass contributes. We study eleven loop designs and training variants on three checkpoints of one vision-language architecture. Our protocol distinguishes whether a model uses its extra pass, whether its image states respond to the query, and whether those updates improve retrieval. We prove that an image placed before the query remains query-independent through repeated layers when information only travels forward. We then open a query-to-image path in three ways, including order-alternating recurrence, which places the query first on the next pass. Each path produces query-sensitive image states. For bidirectional attention and order alternation, freezing later visual updates does not lower accuracy. On all 78 datasets of the Massive Multimodal Embedding Benchmark version 2 (MMEB-V2), a standard added loop loses 0.46 points against its trained control; an intermediate generative stage changes the effect to +0.36. A model pretrained with recurrence gains +4.23 points over its own loop-removed control and benefits from query-conditioned image updates when answering visual questions or locating objects from text.
papers.summary: 更紧凑的通用多模态 embedding 模型，能不能靠把同一组层再跑一遍，做出更好的检索向量？只看检索分数变高，还看不出多出来的这一遍贡献了什么。如果信息只会向前传，把图像放在查询前面，反复过层后图像状态仍与查询无关。作者比较了十一类循环设计，并打开查询流向图像的通路，例如下一遍先放查询。在大规模多模态 embedding 基准第二版的全部数据集上，普通加一层循环比对照低 0.46 分，中间加一段生成则变为高出 0.36 分；带循环预训练的模型，比去掉循环的对照高出 4.23 分。==多跑一遍层并不自动有用，要看图像状态有没有真正用上查询==。对做图文检索 embedding 的人来说，先问额外计算有没有让图像对查询敏感，再决定要不要把循环写进预训练。

papers.title: When Does Label-Free Deconfounding of Document Embeddings Work?
papers.authors: Anna Kiepura, Yingqiang Gao, Elliott Ash, Yu Fan
papers.abstract: Document embeddings encode spurious attributes that can distort semantic comparisons; yet supervised erasure requires metadata that is often unavailable. We systematically investigate label-free deconfounding across corpora and embedding models. Our results show that label-free methods improve semantic utility over unprocessed embeddings, while simple geometric approaches recover much of the supervised benefit, sometimes matching metadata-supervised erasure in linear confounder recoverability and semantic utility. We identify two distinct causes of ineffective erasure: poor proxy-confounder alignment and insufficient intervention coverage. Crucially, confounder recoverability and semantic utility are distinct dimensions of deconfounding success: utility can improve despite residual confounder information, while stronger suppression does not necessarily improve utility. Moreover, reduced linear recoverability can coexist with substantial nonlinear recoverability. Together, these findings distinguish confounder discovery from intervention effectiveness and highlight the importance of evaluating nuisance suppression alongside semantic preservation.
papers.summary: 文档 embedding 会写入一些和语义无关的干扰属性，有监督擦除又常常缺元数据。作者在多个语料和嵌入模型上系统比较了无标签去混淆。无标签方法相对未处理向量能提高语义效用，简单的几何方法也能收回很大一部分有监督收益。在 SwiLTra 上，不用元数据的聚类擦除与用元数据的监督擦除打平，线性泄漏 AUC 同为 0.577，检索 R@10 同为 0.969。效用提高并不要求干扰信息被擦干净，压得更干净也不一定带来更高效用；线性上更难恢复，非线性上仍可能残存不少。==去混淆成功与否，要同时看干扰是否被压住，以及语义任务有没有变好==。对用文档向量做检索或比对的人来说，没有标签也可以先试几何擦除，但必须把这两项分开评，不能只看一项。

papers.title: HypRAG: Hyperbolic Dense Retrieval for Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.authors: Hiren Madhu, Ngoc Bui, Ali Maatouk, Leandros Tassiulas, Smita Krishnaswamy, Menglin Yang, Sukanta Ganguly, Kiran Srinivasan, Zhitao Ying
papers.abstract: Embedding geometry plays a fundamental role in retrieval quality, yet dense retrievers for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) remain largely confined to Euclidean space. However, natural language exhibits hierarchical structure from broad topics to specific entities that Euclidean embeddings fail to preserve, causing semantically distant documents to appear spuriously similar and increasing hallucination risk. To address these limitations, we introduce hyperbolic dense retrieval, developing two model variants in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space: HyTE-FH, a fully hyperbolic transformer, and HyTE-H, a hybrid architecture projecting pre-trained Euclidean embeddings into hyperbolic space. To prevent representational collapse during sequence aggregation, we introduce the Outward Einstein Midpoint, a geometry-aware pooling operator that provably preserves hierarchical structure. On MTEB, HyTE-FH outperforms equivalent Euclidean baselines, while on RAGBench, HyTE-H achieves up to 29% gains over Euclidean baselines in context relevance and answer relevance using substantially smaller models than current state-of-the-art retrievers. Our analysis also reveals that hyperbolic representations encode document specificity through norm-based separation—with over 20% radial increase from general to specific concepts—a property absent in Euclidean embeddings, underscoring the critical role of geometric inductive bias in faithful RAG systems. The code is available at: https://github.com/Graph-and-Geometric-Learning/HypRAG
papers.summary: 密集检索几乎都在欧氏空间里做，但语言从宽主题到具体实体是分层的，欧氏向量难以保住这种结构，语义上远离的文档会看起来很近，加重幻觉风险。HypRAG 在双曲空间的洛伦兹模型里做密集检索，一种是完全双曲的变换器，另一种把预训练好的欧氏向量再映进去，并用向外的爱因斯坦中点做序列汇聚，以免层次在汇聚时塌掉。在 RAGBench 上，相对欧氏基线，混合模型在上下文相关性和答案相关性上最多提高 29%；完全双曲模型里，从一般概念到具体概念的半径增加了 20.2%，欧氏 embedding 没有这种结构。==检索空间的几何假设，会决定层次关系能不能被保住==。对做检索增强生成的人来说，换一个能表达层次的空间，有时比把欧氏检索器再做大更有效。

papers.title: Bioformer-RetroMAE: retrieval-oriented pretraining of a compact biomedical language model for literature search
papers.abstract: Dense retrieval is increasingly used for biomedical literature search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Most biomedical bi-encoders are built on BERTBase-sized encoders pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM). These encoders are costly for corpus-scale indexing and latency-sensitive query encoding, and MLM does not explicitly train the [CLS] vector that a bi-encoder uses to represent a whole text. We present Bioformer-RetroMAE, a compact (43M-parameter) retrieval-oriented biomedical encoder obtained by continually pretraining Bioformer8L} with RetroMAE on approximately 32 million PubMed titles and abstracts. After bi-encoder fine-tuning with BM25 hard negatives, we evaluated it on BioASQ Task 12B test questions by retrieving from all PubMed abstracts. Bioformer-RetroMAE outperformed BioBERT and PubMedBERT bi-encoders fine-tuned under identical settings on all metrics, despite having about 40% of their parameters and producing 512-dimensional rather than 768-dimensional vectors. Compared with PubMedBERT, it improved mean average precision (MAP) by 37.0% and Recall@100 by 29.1%. Compared with the original Bioformer8L}, RetroMAE pretraining improved MAP by 53.6% and Recall@100 by 32.8% without changing model size or inference cost. In hybrid retrieval, fusing Bioformer-RetroMAE with BM25 through weighted reciprocal rank fusion improved MAP and NDCG@10 over BM25 alone by 4.9% and 4.6%, respectively, larger gains than those obtained by fusing BM25 with PubMedBERT or BioBERT.
papers.summary: 生物医学文献检索越来越多用双编码器，但常用的 BERT 规模编码器做全库索引和低延迟查询编码成本高，掩码语言模型也并不直接训练用来代表整段文本的向量。Bioformer-RetroMAE 在约 3200 万条 PubMed 题录和摘要上，用面向检索的 RetroMAE 继续预训练紧凑的 Bioformer 八层模型，再用 BM25 难负例做双编码器微调。在 BioASQ 第 12 届 B 任务测试题、检索全部 PubMed 摘要时，它在所有指标上超过同样微调的 BioBERT 和 PubMedBERT，参数大约只有它们的四成。相对 PubMedBERT，平均精度均值提高 37.0%，Recall@100 提高 29.1%。==面向检索的预训练，能让更小的生物医学编码器在全库检索里超过更大的掩码语言模型==。对做文献搜索或生物医学检索增强生成的人来说，先改预训练目标，可能比继续上更大的编码器更划算。

papers.title: Reranking in RAG: How to Fix Bad Retrieval with a Reranker
papers.summary: 向量检索擅长找到主题相近的段落，却常把细节不对的近错结果排在前面。即使得分最高的几条里没有正确答案，只要正确信息在文档库里，生成仍可能答错。重排是在向量检索取出一批候选之后，用 cross-encoder 对照问题给每段重新打分。在一个 274 道题的合成基准上，Gemini embedding 单独做向量检索时，正确段落排在第一的比例是 81%；用专用重排模型对前三十条再打分后，这一比例升到 97%。作者也提醒，这是小规模合成数据上的结果，真实文档上的收益还要按自己的语料来测。==检索错了，不一定要先换更大的 embedding 模型，先给候选做一次对照问题的重排==。对做检索增强生成的人来说，把候选从三十条收到三条再送给生成模型，是一条可以先量起来的路径。
